summary: Phase 2 (inactivity soft-flag/aging apps/48h follow-up/reactivate) + Phase 3 (image ?w= resize) verified. Backend pytest: 8/8 pass. UI: Dashboard aging card renders + row click navigates to application detail; MemberDetail shows amber Inactive badge and Reactivate button which successfully clears the flag on click (badge + button disappear after reload). Public event images and Gallery use ?w= thumbnails with loading='lazy' (no broken images). PUT /api/members/{id}/reactivate: staff 200, volunteer 403. Cron 200 with WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET, 401 without. Image resize: 2.9MB PNG -> 39KB at ?w=200 (~74x reduction) — confirmed on real seeded event image via /api/public/files/{id}?w=200.

minor.issue: Backend sets Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400 / private, max-age=3600 but ingress/edge (Cloudflare) overrides it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' — browser caching benefit from Phase 3 is lost end-to-end. Payload savings from ?w= still deliver most of the perf win. Not a code bug in server.py; would need infra-level allowlist for image endpoints.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate ingress rewrite that strips backend Cache-Control on /api/public/files/* — file endpoints will not benefit from browser/CDN caching until fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3852 lines — long past the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into modules (files/images, members, applications, reminders, dashboards).
Deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') usage — migrate to lifespan handlers.

/api/public/files/{id} sets Cache-Control but the response reaching the browser is 'no-store' (verified via curl). Add a note or headers pass-through at ingress; otherwise Phase 3 caching gains are only bandwidth-side.
